cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
find_package(cmocka REQUIRED)

foreach(test test_builder test_null_guards test_thread_local)
    add_executable(${test} ${test}.c)
    target_link_libraries(${test} PRIVATE GeoTrace::C cmocka::cmocka)
    add_test(NAME ${test} COMMAND ${test})
    set_tests_properties(${test} PROPERTIES
        ENVIRONMENT "LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:GeoTrace::C>:$ENV{LD_LIBRARY_PATH}"
    )
endforeach()

# Round-trip test uses the minimal fixture generated by gen_fixture.
set(GTD_FIXTURE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/fixtures/minimal.gtd")
if(EXISTS "${GTD_FIXTURE}")
    target_compile_definitions(test_builder PRIVATE
        GTD_FIXTURE_PATH="${GTD_FIXTURE}"
    )
endif()
